state.request: Install and run https://github.com/steel-dev/steel-browser on the dyaus host for use from this BB environment, then create a new independently installable BB plugin in this repository that integrates Steel as the replacement browser infrastructure for the prior KERNEL.SH-based workflow. state.message: Removed unwanted footer action. Confirmed BB masks branding.icon, so introduced transparent outline nav-icon.svg and preserved colored icon.svg as light/dark logo. Fixed context-free nav page with validated project selector and sessionStorage selection persistence; active viewer starts automatically with scoped sessions. Added direct BB Connect authentication link. Build/install/reload succeeded; typecheck passed before final small additions. Real BB desktop 1280/mobile 390 checks confirmed retained bb-plugins selection, one live/idle session, mounted viewer, no overflow or JS errors. Unauthenticated viewer shows BB Connect sign-in; did not bypass authentication or claim authenticated playback. Updated browser fixtures but did not run test suites. Synced origin/main cleanly.

lifecycle.riskRequest: Fix the Steel Browser Tools settings panel so it never sends undefined projectId values over RPC. When no BB project context is available, render a clear project-unavailable state instead of calling project RPC, while keeping Jev host configuration visible. Add focused coverage, rebuild, reload, and update the existing draft PR.

sizeDecision.reason: This is a narrow correction to the existing Steel Browser Tools surface and must ship with the same plugin capability; splitting would leave the known settings error unresolved.
